GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

   A. 50 °C

   D. 100 °C

   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

18. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

   C. Overgrazing continuously
